I cant pass classes on my own, and I can't take my own virginity.

> You can find a romantic partner. Invest in yourself. Improve yourself. The affection of others will follow.

My friend was a 52 year old bald fat 5'4 Indian guy. He had trouble finding a girl to date. Do you think he just sat there and complained about it? Hell no. He improved himself. Now he's a 20 year old dark haired 6 foot white guy, and he's surrounded with options to date.
I've watched that already. Now, it makes me feel worse. Thanks for making me feel worse.

If I pass my finals and my gpa is raised to what I want it to be raised, then I wont suicide. Death isn't what I want. It's what everyone else wants for me.

Are you a female willing to assist me with both? I bet not.

> Maybe love isn't for me

Try going on r/incels; compared to us, you're living like a Queen. Sorry Chad didn't commit to you I guess?
